cards.label: What's at stake
cards.text: In DMZ, anything not placed in a Secure Slot is lost if you fail to Exfil.

cards.label: How exfil works
cards.text: Call in the helicopter, then hold the site until it arrives.

cards.label: NULL notes
cards.text: Half a million, not yet extracted. The official word is "hope."

cards.label: What's next
cards.text: Season 1 adds a new DMZ area and bosses.

outro.text: One number: 20 Points per successful Exfil.

title: MW4 DMZ: the one number that matters (NULL//SMIRK reacts)
description_intro: NULL//SMIRK watches a DMZ extraction moment from MrBeast Gaming's Modern Warfare 4 video and adds official context: what you lose if you fail to Exfil, how an Exfil works, what Season 1 adds to DMZ, and one number from the Season 1 BlackCell challenge: 20 Points per successful Exfil toward a 100-Point goal (that is five exfils, our arithmetic).
derived_notes: o2 'Five exfils': arithmetic from f8, 100 Points needed / 20 Points per successful DMZ Exfil = 5. The page states both numbers, not the result. The 100-Point criterion belongs to BlackCell Challenge Two (f8/f9); the on-screen card says so.
c3 'Half a million, not yet extracted': describes the clip ('$500,000 boys' said at 25.74 s) and is NULL's remark; 'hope' is from f5.
c4 'Season 1 adds a new DMZ area and bosses': paraphrase of f4 ('a new area, bosses, and other bonus content in DMZ'), the official page gives no detail on which area or bosses; none is claimed.
o2 'Survival not included' and o3 'one bag' are opinion/jokes about the clip, not claims about game content.
i1 'Math.', i2 'Hefty.': jokes, no factual content.
